subject: maths
question: Three water pipes m, n and p, take 5, 6 and 12 hours, respectively, to fill a water tank. If all three pipes are opened at the same time, then the required time to fill the water tank will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Times: m = 5 h, n = 6 h, p = 12 h

**Calculations:**

LCM(5,6,12) = 60 ⇒ Total work = 60 units

Efficiency of m = 60 ÷ 5 ⇒ 12 units/h

Efficiency of n = 60 ÷ 6 ⇒ 10 units/h

Efficiency of p = 60 ÷ 12 ⇒ 5 units/h

Combined efficiency = 12 + 10 + 5 ⇒ 27 units/h

⇒ Time = 60 ÷ 27 = 20 ÷ 9 hours = 2(2)/(9) hours 

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
